CAPABILITIES.TITLE: Active capabilities
CAPABILITIES.DESCRIPTION: This is a read-only view of the active runtime configuration.

QUALITY.TITLE: Items needing review
QUALITY.DESCRIPTION: These counts help the team investigate operational inconsistencies. They do not change conversations, appointments, or the assistant.

ATTENTION_LEVELS.CLEAR: No operational investigation is currently needed

SERVICE_HOURS.TITLE: Elis service hours
SERVICE_HOURS.DESCRIPTION: Define when Elis may reply automatically. Messages received outside these hours wait for the next opening; clinical-risk situations follow the immediate protocol.
SERVICE_HOURS.RESTRICT_HINT: Turn this off to allow automatic replies 24 hours a day.
SERVICE_HOURS.TIMEZONE_HINT: Use an IANA time zone, such as America/Sao_Paulo or Europe/Lisbon.
SERVICE_HOURS.CLOSED: No automatic service on this day.
SERVICE_HOURS.ALWAYS_ON: Elis is allowed to reply 24 hours a day.
SERVICE_HOURS.SAVED: Service hours saved. The rule applies to future messages.
SERVICE_HOURS.INVALID: Review the periods: at least one valid, non-overlapping interval is required.
SERVICE_HOURS.CONFLICT: Service hours changed elsewhere. Reload before saving.
SERVICE_HOURS.ERROR: Service hours could not be loaded or saved. The previous configuration remains active.

ASSISTANT_DRAFT.TITLE: Identity and voice
ASSISTANT_DRAFT.DESCRIPTION: Edit only how Elis introduces itself and communicates. Saving creates a draft and does not change live conversations.
ASSISTANT_DRAFT.ENABLED: Use this cluster in the next published version
ASSISTANT_DRAFT.DRAFT_ONLY: This draft is not published and does not change the active assistant.
ASSISTANT_DRAFT.CONFLICT: This draft changed elsewhere. Reload it before saving your changes.
ASSISTANT_DRAFT.ERROR: The draft could not be loaded or saved. No live configuration was changed.

ASSISTANT_SIMULATION.TITLE: Synthetic draft preview
ASSISTANT_SIMULATION.DESCRIPTION: Run an approved synthetic scenario against this saved draft. It never sends a message, changes CRM, creates an appointment, or publishes the draft.
ASSISTANT_SIMULATION.DRAFT_REQUIRED: Save this draft before running a preview.
ASSISTANT_SIMULATION.ERROR: The preview is temporarily unavailable. No message or configuration was changed.
ASSISTANT_SIMULATION.REVIEW_ONLY: This result is for human review only. It is not a publication decision.
ASSISTANT_SIMULATION.REVIEW_DESCRIPTION: Elis reruns this same synthetic scenario on the server before recording your decision.
ASSISTANT_SIMULATION.REVIEW_APPROVED: Synthetic review approved. A separate confirmation is required before publishing.
ASSISTANT_SIMULATION.REVIEW_ERROR: The review could not be recorded. The draft remains unchanged.
ASSISTANT_SIMULATION.PUBLICATION_DESCRIPTION: Publishing changes the assistant configuration for future conversations. It does not change past conversations, CRM records, appointments, or payments.
ASSISTANT_SIMULATION.PUBLICATION_CONFIRMATION: I reviewed this synthetic result and want to publish this draft for future conversations.
ASSISTANT_SIMULATION.PUBLICATION_SUCCEEDED: The reviewed draft was published for future conversations.
ASSISTANT_SIMULATION.PUBLICATION_ERROR: The draft could not be published. The active assistant configuration remains unchanged.

PAUSE.CONFIRM: Elis stops answering patients until you resume. Continue?
PAUSE.CONFLICT: Someone else changed this. Reload to see the current state.
PAUSE.UNAVAILABLE: Could not reach the assistant service.

QUALIFY_HANDOFF.TITLE: Service + qualification and handoff + CRM
QUALIFY_HANDOFF.DESCRIPTION: Elis qualifies the contact, keeps the CRM updated, and transfers the conversation to the team when needed.

SCHEDULE.TITLE: Service through scheduling + CRM
SCHEDULE.DESCRIPTION: Elis qualifies, moves the opportunity stage, schedules when possible, and hands off when the customer asks for a person.

COMPLETE.TITLE: Complete service + scheduling, payment and CRM
COMPLETE.DESCRIPTION: Elis completes the journey, including a confirmed appointment and payment-link delivery, while keeping CRM history consistent.

KNOWLEDGE.TITLE: What Elis knows
KNOWLEDGE.DESCRIPTION: Editing saves a draft. Elis only changes what she says when you publish.
KNOWLEDGE.VERSIONS_DESCRIPTION: Elis keeps using the published base until you publish on purpose. Saving stores the draft without changing anything in production.
KNOWLEDGE.TAXONOMY_NOTE: The subjects come from the taxonomy configured for this clinic — not a fixed list.
KNOWLEDGE.ROLLBACK_WARNING: Going back swaps the whole active base for the content of that date. It asks for confirmation; publishing does too.
KNOWLEDGE.CHECK_CONTRADICTION: Contradiction with other items — not checked yet, the service does not exist
KNOWLEDGE.CHECK_IMPACT: This item touches a sensitive subject. Confirm before publishing.
KNOWLEDGE.EMPTY_DESCRIPTION: Add the first fact so Elis can answer about it.
KNOWLEDGE.PUBLISHED: Published. Elis is already using it.
KNOWLEDGE.CONFLICT: Someone else edited this. Reload to see the current version.
KNOWLEDGE.UNAVAILABLE: Could not reach the assistant service.
KNOWLEDGE.SENSITIVE_DESCRIPTION: These subjects change what Elis states as fact to patients:
KNOWLEDGE.ROLLBACK_CONFIRM: Restoring replaces the whole knowledge base with this version. Continue?

OPPORTUNITY.SUMMARY_EMPTY: Elis has not recorded an operational update yet.

JOURNEY.NEW: A new service conversation has started.
JOURNEY.TRIAGE: Elis is identifying the reason for contact.

JOURNEY.SCHEDULING: Elis is completing the scheduling process.
JOURNEY.PAYMENT_PENDING: The appointment is awaiting payment confirmation.
JOURNEY.PAID: The appointment and payment have been confirmed.
JOURNEY.HANDOFF: The conversation has been transferred to a human agent.
JOURNEY.CLOSED: Elis is no longer handling this conversation.

SETTINGS.TITLE: Elis opportunity tab
SETTINGS.DESCRIPTION: Choose the CRM boards where the read-only Elis operational tab is available. Only boards published in the Elis CRM catalog can be saved.
SETTINGS.ENABLED: Show the IA tab on selected boards
SETTINGS.ENABLED_HINT: Disabling it hides the tab without deleting the previous operational history.
SETTINGS.ERROR: The IA tab configuration could not be loaded or saved. No changes were applied.
